answer: Concretely, the economy can chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. An identity earns only when its pearl recurs, its island survives audit, and a grove from an unlinked peer confirms it.
